rationale: Withhold the index diagnosis. Clearing core.diagnoses alone is not enough (D-04): a medication's purpose field names the condition it treats, so all three medication lists are dropped, including the ones nested under a treatment option. Past medical history and the chief complaint are kept because a real patient knows both, with index-diagnosis terms redacted so they cannot state the answer verbatim (KNOW-5). Treatment free text is redacted for the same reason while the treatments themselves stay visible.
